name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: lead_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Find and list potential leads interested in {product_description} within the {target_market} market.
prompts.use_case: Startups seeking automated lead generation and outreach without manual prospecting.

prompts.name: email_personalization_prompt
prompts.template: Create a personalized outreach email for {lead_name} describing how {product_description} addresses their needs.
prompts.use_case: Sales teams automating cold email campaigns targeted by market segment.
